title: Swords and projectiles smash pots and cut grass
player_outcome: Swinging a sword or firing an arrow through a pot shatters it and spills its loot. Sword swings mow tall grass, flowers and mushrooms, just like exploring caves in Terraria.
design: Verified: HitObject is only reached from the tool path (ItemUseSystem.cs:107). MeleeSystem only sweeps NPCs; projectiles never touch objects.

MeleeSystem.Tick: for each active swing, compute the AABB (cells) of the blade segment samples (P3-04 geometry) and query World.TileObjects.InBox. BreakByAttack objects intersecting the segment → Editor.BreakObject(obj, dropItems: true), which raises ObjectHit Broken (P3-21).
ProjectileSystem: each tick, for friendly projectiles, check TileObjects.At(cell of position) for BreakByAttack → BreakObject. The projectile continues without losing pierce.
Optional grass seeds: a 'grass_cut' loot table (grass_seeds 5% if the item exists) on grass tufts.
data_changes: breakByAttack true: pot, grass_tuft, flower, fern, mushroom_plant, glowing_mushroom_plant (and other decor plants; not stalagmites or rubble)
tests: AttackBreaksObjectsTests: a copper_broadsword swing breaks a pot 1.5 m in front and spawns its loot
AttackBreaksObjectsTests: a wooden arrow through a grass_tuft removes it and keeps flying; hostile projectiles do not break pots
Smoke combat.cmds: 'place pot 0 0 3' / 'wield copper_broadsword' / 'aim 0 -0.3 1' / 'use' / 'wait 0.5' / 'assert objects.count == 0' (the arena is cleared of objects beforehand)
verification: Lavapipe: pot shatter with chips and sound
risks: The TileObjects.InBox query per tick per swing: bound the box to ≤ 8×8×8 cells and only during active swings.
